prompt:
Research the officially documented limits of Vercel's free Hobby plan (bandwidth, function invocations or duration, build minutes). Cite Vercel's documentation and quote the limits.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Below are the currently documented limits for Vercel’s free Hobby plan as of 2026-10-10. The following lines meet the required format, with each quote copied verbatim from Vercel’s official documentation.

SOURCE: https://vercel.com/docs/plans/hobby | QUOTE: "The Hobby plan is free and aimed at developers with personal projects, and small-scale applications." | CLAIM: The Hobby plan is free and intended for personal or small-scale use.

SOURCE: https://vercel.com/docs/plans/hobby | QUOTE: "Fast Data Transfer | First 100 GB" | CLAIM: The free Hobby bandwidth (Fast Data Transfer) limit is the first 100 GB per month.

SOURCE: https://vercel.com/docs/plans/hobby | QUOTE: "Function Invocations | First 1,000,000" | CLAIM: The Hobby plan includes the first 1,000,000 serverless function invocations per month at no cost.

SOURCE: https://vercel.com/docs/plans/hobby | QUOTE: "Active CPU | 4 CPU-hrs" | CLAIM: The Hobby plan includes 4 CPU-hours of active compute time per month.

SOURCE: https://vercel.com/docs/plans/hobby | QUOTE: "Provisioned Memory | 360 GB-hrs" | CLAIM: The Hobby plan includes 360 GB-hours of provisioned memory per month.

SOURCE: https://vercel.com/docs/limits | QUOTE: "Build Time per Deployment (Minutes) | 45 | 45 | 45" | CLAIM: Each deployment on the Hobby plan has a maximum build time of 45 minutes.

SOURCE: https://vercel.com/docs/limits | QUOTE: "When the limit is reached, the Build Step will be interrupted and the Deployment will fail." | CLAIM: If a build exceeds 45 minutes, it will be interrupted and the deployment will fail.

SOURCE: https://vercel.com/docs/limits | QUOTE: "You are able to build `100` Deployments every `3600` seconds (1 hour)." | CLAIM: The Hobby plan allows up to 100 builds per hour.

SOURCE: https://vercel.com/docs/plans/hobby | QUOTE: "In most cases, if you exceed your usage limits on the Hobby plan, you will have to wait until 30 days have passed before you can use the feature again." | CLAIM: Exceeding Hobby plan usage limits generally requires waiting 30 days before the feature can be used again.

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: A documented monthly build minutes cap (e.g., a specific number of build minutes per month) separate from the 45-minute per-build limit.
